Organization bearing an effective regulatory mandate for a specified jurisdiction and functional scope.
decisions.recommendation: Ground authority in mandate, independently of whether it has already performed a regulatory act.
decisions.boundary: Conferring institution must be evidenced; do not invent a grantor or recursively require it to bear the same mandate.

decisions.definition: Organization bearing product/label responsibility through an explicit responsibility episode or the already justified listing-responsibility context.
decisions.recommendation: Preserve ListingResponsibleOrganizationRole as one route; add ProductLabelCommitmentOrganizationRole as an alternative. Use an overlapping covering set only for the bounded proposed scope; never require both routes.
decisions.boundary: Product-side subject roles do not make the product responsible. No inference of manufacturing, market approval or mandatory listing from label responsibility.

decisions.recommendation: Adopt this bounded institutional profile for the current candidate; defer direct-person entitlement until a Person identity and eligible-beneficiary pattern are justified.
